data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Query endpoint request error-rate metrics for a WhatsApp Flow (Meta WhatsApp Flows API)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request queries the ENDPOINT_REQUEST_ERROR_RATE metric for a specified Flow over a date range, matching the goal of querying application error metrics. No supplied requests are irrelevant.

AUTH
  Bearer token authentication
  Header: Authorization: Bearer <access-token>. The collection references {{access-token}}, but does not provide its value; supply a valid token separately.

BASE URL
  https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0

STEPS
  1. GET /{{flow-id}}
     Params (query):
       fields: string — 'metric.name(ENDPOINT_REQUEST_ERROR_RATE).granularity(LIFETIME).since(2024-01-28).until(2024-01-30)' — request the metric, granularity, start date, and end date.
       flow-id: string — '<FLOW_ID>' — replace the path variable with the target Flow ID.
     Returns:
       200 OK; an object containing id (string), metric.granularity (string), metric.name (string), and metric.data_points (array). Each data point contains timestamp (string) and data (array) with key (string) and value (number).
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Send the fields value as a URL query parameter and URL-encode it as needed; it is not a request body field.
  - Replace both collection placeholders before calling: {{base-url}} resolves to the origin above and {{flow-id}} must be replaced with a real Flow ID.
  - The collection is marked deprecated and directs callers to the Flows folder in the WhatsApp Cloud API collection.
  - The saved example uses dates 2024-01-28 through 2024-01-30 and LIFETIME granularity; change the fields expression if a different interval or granularity is required.
